body: User decision on bd-01M3ZTJXDBAPTSPDX5ECXRQ3CA: hollow point glyphs are picked on their whole disc by default on every host, with an explicit option to restore outline-only. A worktree agent of mine is changing only the shared default in modules/interaction (PickPolicy); it will not touch modules/browser*. Since you own SvgWidget/SvgWidgetView/WidgetOptions for 08, please (a) expose the picking policy in WidgetOptions (passed to Picking.fromResolved in SvgWidgetView.compile and your Canvas path), and (b) add a browser check hovering a hollow point's centre under the default and under the explicit outline option. Also landed today: Canvas text plates b93c106, JavaFX 12f0488; consumer gate 5a27028 passes; 07 is 829b03e. Base your 08 candidate on current main.
